outcome_detail: Both suits were filed in 2026 (one in March 2026 against Inspector Jeremy Scheublin; one in July 2026 against the City of New York, Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch, and Deputy Inspector Juan O. Moran) and were newly pending as of July 2026. No resolution reported.
criminal_detail: Inspector Jeremy Scheublin was indicted by a Bronx grand jury and arraigned on July 10, 2026 on charges including attempted rape, sexual abuse, assault, unlawful imprisonment, forcible touching, official misconduct, and obstructing governmental administration, stemming from an alleged January 2025 assault on a female subordinate in his 46th Precinct office. He pleaded not guilty; his next court date was set for October 30, 2026. No criminal charges reported against Juan O. Moran.
description: Female NYPD members assigned to the 46th Precinct in the Bronx brought two lawsuits in 2026 alleging sexual harassment and assault by successive commanding officers. In a suit filed in March 2026, a female officer alleged that Inspector Jeremy Scheublin subjected her to a pattern of unwanted advances and inappropriate comments beginning after his December 2023 arrival at the precinct, culminating in a January 1, 2025 encounter in which, according to the complaint, he grabbed her, threw her onto a couch, and attempted to remove her gun belt before she fought him off. In July 2026, Bronx prosecutors announced Scheublin's indictment on attempted rape and related charges over the alleged assault; he pleaded not guilty. A day before his arraignment, a female sergeant and two female officers from the same precinct sued the City of New York, Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch, and Scheublin's successor, Deputy Inspector Juan O. Moran, alleging sexual harassment, hostile work environment, retaliation, and racial discrimination; the complaint describes conduct including an unwanted tight hug, sexual comments, and untying a knot securing one officer's dress, and characterizes the precinct as a 'personal sexual playground.' Both civil cases and the criminal case were pending as of July 2026.

confidence_notes: This record aggregates two closely related 2026 filings arising from the 46th Precinct (multiple_filings=true): the March 2026 suit against Scheublin by his alleged victim, and the July 2026 suit by three other female members of service against the City, Commissioner Tisch, and Deputy Inspector Moran. The plaintiffs in the July suit are named in public reporting but are omitted here under the victim-naming rule. The exact filing date of the July suit (reported as the day before the July 10, 2026 arraignment) and the court(s) of filing were not confirmed. Some outlets describe the top criminal count as attempted rape, amNewYork's summary said 'rape charges'; the indictment as described by CBS and Gothamist lists attempted rape. Moran has not been criminally charged and the allegations against him and Tisch/the City are unproven allegations from the complaint.
